annotations.title: Get back into a book when the handle is gone.

description: Call it with the email address the book belongs to and Chorus sends that address an eight digit code, returning nothing about the books. Call it again with the address and the code and it hands back every book on that account with its handle. Holding the mailbox is the proof, so a book cannot be found by guessing an address.

code.description: The eight digit code that was emailed. Leave it out on the first call to have one sent.

email.description: The email address the book belongs to.
